High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- Kaushalendra Nath Singh
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Kshitij Shailendra,J.
1.

The prayer made in the instant petition is for a direction to respondent no.3 to decide the application of the petitioner dated 23.05.2022 under Section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 within a stipulated period.
2.
Shri Kaushalendra Nath Singh, learned counsel for the respondent-Authority does not dispute about the pendency of the application.

He tried to contend that the order passed in First Appeal No.458 of 1982 on basis of which the petitioner is claiming enhancement of compensation, was in Rajvir Singh And 7 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 9 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/2809871/
1 respect of a different notification.
3.

entities.text: Rajvir Singh And 7 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 9 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In our opinion, the said issue should be examined, in the first instance, by the Collector, before whom application is pending.

4. We dispose of the instant petition with direction to respondent no.3 to decide the application,
expeditiously, preferable within twelve weeks from the date of communication of the instant order.
5. The NOIDA Authority will be at liberty to raise all possible pleas in opposition to the application.

Order Date :- 9.4.2024 Ankit.
